messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — proposing we unpin runtime v1.8.0 and enable v1.9.0 on canary at 16:00 UTC today. Reason: Llama2Q v2 compatibility fixes landed in runtime 1.9 that avoid OOMs for long-contexts. Need infra + SRE signoff.

cory: Do we have a rollback plan if we see perf regressions?

maya: Yes — rollback is simply re-applying the pin via deploybot and routing traffic back to v1.8.0. Steps:
```
/deploybot pin runtime=1.8.0 --scope=canary
/deploybot unroute runtime=1.9.0 --scope=canary
```
We'll keep canary at 5% and monitor 30m before increasing.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: unpin runtime v1.8.0 -> allow v1.9.0 on canary at 1745016000 (16:00 UTC). Canary traffic: 5%. Automated healthchecks enabled.

eva: Please add a short note to the Release Notes and the internal changelog (inc. the kv-cache behavior change). Also ping support for possible customer tickets.

ben: Running the embedding regression suite now — if anything fails we should hold. Already seeing one noisy quantization delta on model x-embed-512. Will report within 10m.

julian: If embedding regression shows up, can we route existing critical customers to Dedicated pools while we investigate? We should avoid customer-facing errors.

maya: Good call. If embedding errors > 2% we flip route-policy to dedicated for the affected customer IDs. I'll prepare the routing toggle runbook.

sre-bot: Alert policy: latency_p95 > 600ms OR error_rate > 0.02 for 3 consecutive minutes will trigger pager. Thresholds copied to the canary dashboard.

cory: Approving from infra side assuming rollback is tested. //cory :thumbsup:

eva: Approving docs and support prep. I'll draft the internal blurb and customer FAQ note.

ben: Embedding suite done: small delta on cosine similarity for x-embed-512 (median -0.003) — within acceptable tolerance. No functional errors. Recommend proceeding with canary.

maya: All right — executing unpin now. Will post back with the deploy-bot confirmation and a short checklist (metrics, errors, rollout plan).

deploy-bot: Action: unpin applied to canary at 1745016100. Canary traffic 5% -> live. Healthchecks green.

maya: Checking dashboards — initial token latency +3% p95, error rate stable. Monitoring for 30m before 25% increase.

julian: Noted. If we see embedding quality regression after 25% bump, we revert by re-pinning v1.8.0 and route impacted customers to dedicated.

maya: Thanks all — will update release notes and close thread after 2h stable. :white_check_mark:
